name: walkers_service_a
prompt:
One image is attached: finished art from the same 2D city game, cars seen from above. Match its finish and light only — not its contents, colours or scale.

Make one image: 9 different people for the game, in a grid of 3 columns by 3 rows, read left to right, top to bottom. Each stands still, the whole body facing south — straight down the picture, towards its bottom edge — arms relaxed at the sides, feet side by side, a relaxed neutral expression, head level. The camera is in front and high above, looking down at about 55 degrees: the top of the head and the tops of the shoulders show plainly, the face is seen from above and a little shortened, the legs shorter on the picture than the body above them, the feet tucked just under the hem. Looking down shortens a body top to bottom only; it never makes it wider. Every figure has an ordinary average build — neither thin nor stocky, shoulders their natural width. The whole body is visible. Each is centred in its cell, well apart from its neighbours, never touching. All at one scale: a person 1.8 m tall fills about 70 % of the cell's height, shorter people smaller in proportion.

Style: game sprite art with a light pixel-art feel — clean simplified shapes, bold readable silhouettes, a limited palette with flat shading in two or three tones per colour, crisp hard edges. Leave small details out: no fabric texture, no stitching, no tiny patterns; faces simple, eyes, brows and mouth a few marks. Each must read clearly when shown only 60 pixels tall. Not photographic, not soft painting, not chibi: natural adult proportions. Summer in a Black Sea port city.

The people, in order:
1. 1.82 m tall. A police officer, a man of about 30 with short dark hair, clean-shaven, in a dark-navy police uniform: a short-sleeved shirt with a small silver badge on the chest, dark-navy trousers, a black duty belt, black boots and a dark-navy peaked cap.
2. 1.7 m tall. A police officer, a woman of about 28 with dark-blond hair in a low bun, in a dark-navy police uniform: a short-sleeved shirt with a small silver badge on the chest, dark-navy trousers, a black duty belt and black boots, bareheaded.
3. 1.78 m tall. A police officer, a man of about 45 with short greying hair and a dark moustache, in a dark-navy police uniform: a short-sleeved shirt with a small silver badge on the chest, dark-navy trousers, a black duty belt, black boots and a dark-navy peaked cap.
4. 1.66 m tall. A paramedic, a woman of about 35 with brown hair in a ponytail, in a paramedic's uniform: a red short-sleeved shirt with silver reflective stripes round the arms, dark-navy trousers and black boots.
5. 1.84 m tall. A paramedic, a man of about 25 with short fair hair, in a paramedic's uniform: a red short-sleeved shirt with silver reflective stripes round the arms, dark-navy trousers and black boots.
6. 1.76 m tall. A paramedic, a bald man of about 50 with a short grey beard, in a paramedic's uniform: a red short-sleeved shirt with silver reflective stripes round the arms, dark-navy trousers and black boots.
7. 1.8 m tall. A recovery mechanic, a man of about 40 with short dark hair and a short dark beard, in work clothes: a fluorescent-yellow high-visibility vest with silver reflective stripes over a dark-grey T-shirt, dark-grey work trousers and black work boots.
8. 1.74 m tall. A recovery mechanic, a man of about 55 with short grey hair, in work clothes: a fluorescent-yellow high-visibility vest with silver reflective stripes over a dark-grey T-shirt, dark-grey work trousers and black work boots.
9. 1.68 m tall. A recovery mechanic, a woman of about 30 with red hair in a ponytail, in work clothes: a fluorescent-yellow high-visibility vest with silver reflective stripes over a dark-grey T-shirt, dark-grey work trousers, black work boots and grey work gloves.

Everything outside the figures is fully transparent: no background, no ground, no shadow, nothing half-transparent. No text, letters, numbers, labels, grid lines or frames anywhere.
